reviews.comment: She was a good teacher and definitely knew what she was talking about, but I found her lectures super boring. The way she talks makes me want to fall asleep, and I almost did multiple times in this class. However, if you pay attention and don't zone off, you will be good in this class.

Amazing prof. Good notes, which she posts after class in case you can't make it or want to review. Easy to follow in lecture and open to questions. Posts practice exams and goes over solutions. Not very much homework, but what is there is helpful and doesn't feel like busywork. If you put in the work getting an A in this class is easy.

What a class. Stopped going to lectures a month in because of how slow she talks and explains things. Thought she was just nervous at first but if you ask her a question, she'll usually talk in the same incredibly slow tone. Wow oh wow is this class easy though. 75% is tests and they're pretty much a joke, slap some free HW on and you have an A.
So very sweet. Lectures are helpful, but homework is much harder than lecture examples. Exams usually have one question that is hard to study for.

Rebecca is easily the best of the Dynamics profs you can get. The material is very difficult, but the way she chose to test on it was a lot better than other profs that teach the same stuff. Exams are 80% of your grade, but she makes them pretty fair. Her lectures are tangible, but her explanations are lacking sometimes

Friesen does an excellent job at teaching a very hard class. She is passionate, caring, and does everything she can to help her students understand what is happening. This class is 80% exams so prepare well for them. She allows a cheat sheet for her exams. After recitation is over, take advantage of that time as its like office hours

Dr. Friesen explained the difficult material in a way that made it very understandable. The homeworks were long and tedious but were incredibly helpful and forced you to learn. The exams were straightforward, graded fairly, and were easier than other sections. She is also quite accessible outside of class and genuinely wants you to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Friesen is the best professor to get for MEEN 363, she makes the material understandable and is very helpful with homework problems during recitation. Her exams are far easier than the other prof's exams and she cares about the success of her students
